rule.statement: Co-ownership terminates after 10 years of undisturbed, uninterrupted, and exclusive possession of divided lots, even without cross-conveyances.
rule.supporting_quote: Where a land is divided with the consent of all the co-owners but no cross conveyances are executed in respect of the lots, co-ownership terminates only after undisturbed, uninterrupted and exclusive possession of the divided lots for a period of over ten years
